subject.title: test(repair): add hermetic automerge end-to-end flow

question: May this repository’s production automerge validation execute a digest-pinned image from the contributor-controlled Docker Hub namespace, or must the base be built and provenance-controlled by the repository before merge?
rationale: Digest pinning establishes immutability for the selected image but cannot decide the repository’s acceptable publisher, build, and attestation boundary for CI-executed code.

options.title: Require repository-controlled provenance
options.body: Build and publish the base from the checked-in Dockerfile through a repository-controlled workflow, then pin and verify that resulting digest before enabling this CI job.

options.title: Explicitly accept the external image boundary
options.body: Record a maintainer-approved exception for this named image and publisher, including the ownership and rotation policy that makes the external dependency acceptable.

recommendation.title: Require repository-controlled provenance
recommendation.body: Build and publish the base from the checked-in Dockerfile through a repository-controlled workflow, then pin and verify that resulting digest before enabling this CI job.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository policy names Peter for ClawSweeper workflow handling, and this is a CI trust-boundary decision.
